newsitem.title: TURKEY: FORECAST-Turkey March inflation seen at 5.5-6.0pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Turkey March inflation seen at 5.5-6.0pct.

text.p: Bankers and analysts predicted that Turkey's consumer price index would rise at around 5.5 to six percent in March.
Consumer prices had risen 5.7 percent in February and 5.6 percent in March, 1996.

Year-on-year consumer price inflation will fall to around 76.5 percent from 77.7 percent if the inflation figure to be unveiled on Friday by the State Institute of Statistics, remains in the predicted range, analysts say.
Bankers said the effect of monetary expansion in late 1996 and early 1997 would continue to show its effect on March inflation and in April.
They say public sector pay rises are also expected to push up price levels in April and May.
